title: Slay the Streamer 2
description:
Twitch and YouTube chat votes on the streamer's choices: run start (act variant), Neow and mid-run Ancient blessings, card rewards, and act bosses. Inspired by Tempus's Slay the Streamer for StS1.

Configuration lives in %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\slay_the_streamer_2.json and in the in-game Mods screen once connected.

Setup guide and README: https://github.com/Surfinite/slay-the-streamer-2

Demo: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2782280062
changeNote: v0.3.0: enemies are now named after chat voters (on by default) - fair rotation so everyone gets a turn before repeats (which become 'Jr.', then 'III'), shown under the intent icons. Named enemies also speak their chatter's messages as in-game speech bubbles (configurable duration, 0 = off; raw message text - your channel moderation is the filter). Also: 'Card-reward votes only occur after combat' now defaults ON for new installs (existing configs keep their saved value). Tested against game Beta v0.111.0.
